# Delivery is best-effort by design — a peer being offline must never affect a stage
# outcome. MISCONFIGURATION is not, and used to be indistinguishable from it: the
# daemon has no mess identity of its own (no --as, no session, no $MESS_AGENT), so
# EVERY notification breeze ever sent failed with "no identity" and the error was
# discarded. Nobody noticed, because a failure and a success looked identical from
# breeze's side. Reported by mess-dev, who maintains mess and checked all three live
# daemons' environments.
env BREEZE_DIR=$WORK/state
env PATH=$WORK/bin:${PATH}

exec chmod +x $WORK/bin/mess $WORK/bin/mess-ok $WORK/bin/mess-broken

exec breeze register identity ci
cp stdout ci.token
exec breeze apply -f pipeline.hcl --as ci --token-file ci.token

# A healthy notifier says nothing; status stays quiet.
! exec breeze start stage svc red abc123 --as ci --token-file ci.token
exec sleep 1
exec breeze status
! stdout 'mess notifications'

# A mess that refuses (the daemon's real situation before this) is now REPORTED,
# rather than failing forever in silence.
exec cp $WORK/bin/mess-broken $WORK/bin/mess
! exec breeze start stage svc red def456 --as ci --token-file ci.token
exec sleep 1
exec breeze status
stdout 'mess notifications: FAILING'
stdout 'no identity'
stdout 'stage outcomes are unaffected'

# ...and recovery clears it, so a transient failure doesn't stick forever.
exec cp $WORK/bin/mess-ok $WORK/bin/mess
! exec breeze start stage svc red cafe01 --as ci --token-file ci.token
exec sleep 1
exec breeze status
! stdout 'mess notifications'

exec breeze stop

-- bin/mess-ok --
#!/bin/sh
exit 0
-- bin/mess-broken --
#!/bin/sh
echo "mess: no identity: run \`mess register <name>\`, pass --as NAME, or set MESS_AGENT" >&2
exit 1
-- bin/mess --
#!/bin/sh
exit 0
-- pipeline.hcl --
pipeline "svc" {
  # A failure notifies unconditionally (mess's "user" mailbox), so every case here
  # actually invokes the notifier — a lone SUCCEEDING stage notifies nobody, since
  # there is no next stage whose role holders would care.
  stage "red" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "20s"
    command = ["/bin/false"]
  }
}
